facts.fact: The Data Protection Act, 2024 (Act No. 3 of 2024), assented 31 January 2024, bars a controller or processor from transferring personal data from Malawi unless the recipient is under a law, binding corporate rule, contractual clause, code of conduct or certification affording adequate protection, or consent or a contract condition applies (s.38, s.39); the Act comes into operation on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice (s.1) and the document states no such date, so in-force status is not shown.

systems.owner: Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (as Data Protection Authority)

note: Act empowers the authority to designate adequate countries and approve standard contractual clauses (s.6, s.39) but states none published or applied.
